name.fr-FR: Histoire des variations des Églises protestantes
name.en-US: History of the Variations of the Protestant Churches
name.pt-BR: História das variações das Igrejas protestantes

description.fr-FR: Quinze livres où Bossuet suit, de Luther à la fin du XVIIe siècle, les changements de confession des Églises issues de la Réforme (luthéranisme, Angleterre, calvinisme, albigeois, vaudois, hussites) pour opposer à leurs variations la constance de la doctrine de l’Église catholique. Publié en 1688. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Fifteen books following, from Luther to the end of the seventeenth century, the changes of confession in the Churches born of the Reformation (Lutherans, England, Calvinists, Albigensians, Waldensians, Hussites), to set against their variations the constancy of Catholic doctrine. Published in 1688. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Quinze livros em que Bossuet segue, de Lutero ao fim do século XVII, as mudanças de confissão das Igrejas nascidas da Reforma (luteranos, Inglaterra, calvinistas, albigenses, valdenses, hussitas), para opor às suas variações a constância da doutrina da Igreja católica. Publicado em 1688. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XIV, pages 001-015, and volume XV, pages 002-004. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.

sources.edition: The History of the Variations of the Protestant Churches, anonymous translation, 2 vols., Dublin: Richard Coyne, 1836 (archive.org historyofvariati01boss, historyofvariati02boss; OCR text, cleaned)
sources.description: Books I-XV and the preface; the French remarques historiques and the additions to book XIV have no English counterpart.
